name: Sa Mama 'e su Sole
regionalRelevance: Island-wide tradition, deeply acknowledged in pastoral and agricultural areas comprising Nurra.
traditionalBehavior: Appears during the hottest hours of the day (midday). Leaves a fever mark (halentura) on children who disobey and venture outside.
fictionalTransformation: ORIGINAL_FICTIONAL_TRANSFORMATION: The entity utilizes extreme thermal radiation to mask its approach, targeting the group when physically exposed at an archaeological site without shade.

name: Ammuntadore
regionalRelevance: Known throughout Sardinia, including the northwest. Represents sleep paralysis/night terrors.
traditionalBehavior: A heavy, suffocating presence that sits on the chest of sleeping victims, causing nightmares and immobility.
fictionalTransformation: ORIGINAL_FICTIONAL_TRANSFORMATION: Can manifest through corrupted amulets, trapping a group member in a shared hallucination that overlays physical terrain with false hazards.
